title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: Settle the mitosis engine ARCHITECTURE before any code is written. Audit and research are complete; what remains is one empirical test, then the user's call on three design decisions.
spine.next_step: START HERE, before any design talk: settle decision 0103's open half. Prove whether node:child_process EXECUTES inside a Workflow script or merely resolves — throwaway Workflow script, dynamic import, run a trivial command, read the result. ~30 seconds, and it gates the entire rebuild premise. Then put the three open decisions to the user: durable-execution runtime vs its state model only; default speculation depth; which work-type pipeline first. Do NOT implement — no rebuild is approved.
open_risks: Second-system effect is the primary danger: the correct-feature list is long, and attempting it at once repeats this engine's original sin of ambition outrunning verification.
The bottleneck does not move (0104). Wall-clock barely improves; the wins are token cost and crash-loss. Reset expectations BEFORE seeking approval.
Regression risk on the two things the engine got right: fail-closed halting, and the built/awaiting/done speculation states (0106).
Determinism is a discipline. Replay bugs in a durable orchestrator are subtler than anything currently in the engine.
Six other paused mitosis threads target REPAIRING this engine. A rebuild makes several moot; they need explicit disposition, not silent abandonment.
The running engine is a DIRTY FEATURE BRANCH: ~/.claude symlinks into this repo, four divergent states. Any experiment changes what executes.
The write guard holds every Edit/Write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} for a human, so unattended fan-out on the engine itself is impossible.
out_of_scope: Implementing any rebuild before the user approves one.
Executing the run-readiness-repair spec's 11 MSPs or quiescent-advance M0-M8. Valid repair work, on hold pending the rebuild decision, NOT cancelled.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Editing the current engine, its twins, or its prompts.
